full_details: You spoke the first line alone. Pope's Nurse stopped the play three times. Phillips's Mercutio was laughed with, and then, very suddenly, not. Kemp carried the fan, said what was set down, and one line more. Burbage played a boy at a run. Nick came in under every note. The sun was gone before four. When Romeo called for light, it was brought. You stood behind the arras and then went on as the Prince. Nobody moved at first. The boxes held £12 13s, above the £11 6s of Richard II on the 2nd of October. The share was 40s. The two figures were both said, and not divided. Mistress Ansell had never been inside a playhouse. She went ahead of you. At the door she said good night, and nothing else. The full moon was over Shoreditch church when you were still at the Theatre gate.
one_sentence: Mistress Ansell went in her church hat, the lovers were played, the boxes held twelve pound thirteen, and at the door she said good night.
title: Twelve pound thirteen in the boxes, and good night
